component.name: Textarea
component.description: Multi-line text input with autoresize support and form field integration.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Textarea wrapper that owns header, textarea, footer, and autoresize state.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Optional content rendered above the textarea.

slots.name: input
slots.description: Native textarea control used for multi-line text entry.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Optional content rendered below the textarea.

own.name: autofocus
own.description: Whether to automatically focus the textarea on mount.

own.name: autofocusDelay
own.description: Delay in milliseconds before focusing the textarea.

own.name: autoResize
own.description: Whether the textarea should automatically resize based on content.

own.name: autoResizeDelay
own.description: Delay in milliseconds before triggering autoresize on mount.

own.name: children
own.description: Children elements, rendered inside the root below the textarea.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: defaultValue
own.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether the input is disabled.

own.name: footer
own.description: Element to render below the textarea.

own.name: header
own.description: Element to render above the textarea.

own.name: id
own.description: The ID of the input element.

own.name: maxLength
own.description: Maximum character length for the textarea.

own.name: maxRows
own.description: Maximum number of rows allowed during autoresize.

own.name: modelModifiers
own.description: Modifiers for input processing (e.g., lazy, trim, number).

own.name: name
own.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

own.name: onBlur
own.description: Native blur event handler.

own.name: onChange
own.description: Callback when the textarea value change is committed.

own.name: onFocus
own.description: Native focus event handler.

own.name: onInput
own.description: Native input event handler.

own.name: onValueChange
own.description: Callback when the textarea value changes during input.

own.name: placeholder
own.description: Placeholder text for the textarea.

own.name: readOnly
own.description: Whether the input is read-only.

own.name: required
own.description: Whether the input is required.

own.name: rows
own.description: Default number of rows.

own.name: value
own.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

aria.name: aria-disabled
aria.description: Indicates that the control is disabled.

aria.name: aria-readonly
aria.description: Indicates that the control value cannot be changed by the user.

aria.name: aria-required
aria.description: Indicates that user input is required.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-disabled
ariaAttributes.description: Indicates that the control is disabled.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-readonly
ariaAttributes.description: Indicates that the control value cannot be changed by the user.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-required
ariaAttributes.description: Indicates that user input is required.
